title: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI Release Summary (2024)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per operating system (OS) for the Zscaler Client Connector for VDI on Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.4.0.5 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.4.0.5 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Adds support for port and protocol forwarding options.
Fixes an issue where diagnostic options were incorrectly displayed.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.3.0.16 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.3.0.16 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where a user logged in to two separate devices, which caused an invalid reauthentication loop.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.3.0.14 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.3.0.14 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Contains a new installer parameter, USEEMBEDDEDBROWSER, which enables embedded browser support.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.2.0.19 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.2.0.19 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Changes the name of the application from Zscaler VDI Agent to Zscaler Client Connector for VDI.
Contains a new installer parameter, HIDEAPPONUILAUNCH, which minimizes the application when launching.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.1.0.12 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.1.0.12 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Improves rate limit reauthentication prompts for users.
Fixes an issue where the policy did not update after restarting Zscaler Client Connector for VDI.
Fixes an issue where the driver did not install due to a race condition.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.1.0.8 for Windows
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.1.0.8 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Moves Zscaler Client Connector for VDI's user configuration file to the user's roaming profile folder, which allows you to restore the user-specific configurations using tools such as Citrix UPM or FSLogix.
Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector for VDI caused packet fragmentation, resulting in failed connections to internal Microsoft Azure endpoints.
